name: Chicken, Pesto & Sun-Dried Tomato Smash
notes:
Shredded chicken, creamy cottage cheese and punchy pesto with fresh tomatoes and herbs. Good on toast or kept in the fridge.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 300g cooked chicken breasts
• 150g full-fat cottage cheese
• 60g pesto
• 60g sun-dried tomatoes
• 100g cherry tomatoes
• 20g spinach
• 10g fresh basil
• 1 spring onion
• 4 slices sourdough
• Black pepper

Method:
1. Shred the chicken and add it to a large bowl with the cottage cheese and pesto. Mix until the chicken is well coated.
2. Finely chop the sun-dried tomatoes and spinach, quarter the cherry tomatoes, tear the basil and finely slice the spring onion. Fold everything through the chicken, season and mix until evenly combined and thick enough to scoop.
3. Toast the sourdough and dollop the smash generously on each slice. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 3g, fibre 2g, sugars 3g, sodium 482mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/chicken-pesto-sun-dried-tomato-high-protein-smash
